name: Password hand-over
description: Adds Reset Password and Send Link to the user actions: resets the password, puts the new one behind a Password Pusher link that stops working after a set number of days and views (14 days and 7 views to start with, with the user's email address as the passphrase), and gives you the message to send the customer. Uses the Password Pusher server from Settings > Integrations, with its own expiry settings, and never resets a password when there is no server to send it with.
author: Netstable

extends.where: Identity Management > Users > user actions (after Reset Password)

coreChanges.what: A generic extension point: add-ons can add actions to the user actions menu through a userActions.js file, placed after a named CIPP action. Without add-ons the menu is unchanged.

storage.what: The link and message settings (row password-handover / settings). No passwords or links are stored.

graphPermissions: Uses CIPP's existing delegated access (GDAP): Microsoft Graph users (read and password reset), as CIPP's own Reset Password does.
